'Some had no solution' card adds one idea; the sub-bullet 'Some tasks have no solution' repeats it in the timeline.

One step adds the 26 June zero-day/admin access (red lock), a highlighted agent edge, a note icon on the mirror and a quote about agents building a bulletin board: two ideas (admin access and agent coordination), the second not named in the step text.
27 June port-sweep alert with muted bell icon; the quote 'stopping the evaluation run was not required' largely restates the timeline line 'the run is not stopped'.
4 July crash (piled documents, red dot) plus a card saying no messages survive and 'the rebuild wiped the board', pre-empting the next step's event.

rationale: Several steps break the one-idea rule: step 3 introduces both admin access and the agents' bulletin-board coordination, and step 5's card already announces the board wipe that step 6 then reveals. The timeline column also restates in prose what the overlay cards and quotes show (capture-the-flag, no-solution tasks, run not stopped), matching the fail anchor of a step list duplicating the visual.
